thread:
Ethan (Support): Escalating VeraLabs onboarding — customer reports sporadic embedding latency and 504s during interactive demo. They said renewal conversation is next Thursday; if we don't stabilize by then they may pause. Ticket #456712 created.
Maya (CS Ops): Thanks for the heads-up. Can you paste the latest support log and confirm whether they're on Hosted or Dedicated? I can coordinate the comms plan but need an owner for technical remediation.
Ethan (Support): They're on Dedicated EU pool (eu-west-1), model embed-v1-small (quantized). Failures: 3x 504 over last 24h, median latency jumped from ~120ms to >1.3s during spikes. Logs:
```
REQUEST_ID=4f9c2e
model=embed-v1-small
region=eu-west-1
overall_latency_ms=1320
http_status=504
error=upstream-timeout
prefix_tokens=32
```
Also saw repeated KV cache eviction warnings.
Priya (CSM): I'm happy to lead the customer comms and enablement session, Samir can you own the checkpoint and follow-up? Proposed comms plan (short):
- Immediate: acknowledge escalation + ETA (within 2h) and offer a 1-hour troubleshooting window this afternoon.
- Short-term fix (24–48h): route VeraLabs to our fallback model variant (embed-v1-stable) during demo windows and issue a one-time credit for impacted calls.
- Enablement: 30-min session to walk their engineers through prefix trimming and SDK retry logic; offer a live test.
- Postmortem: 72h post-stabilize with remediation timeline and action items.
Samir (CS Lead): I'll own the checkpoint and run the enablement. @Jo (AE) can you confirm contract renewal date & whether we can offer a formal credit vs one-off? I can also prepare a short proactive status email template.
Jo (AE): Renewal discussion scheduled for next Thu at 10am UTC. We have some margin but prefer to avoid formal concessions. A one-time credit and a committed follow-up with eng is fine. I'll join the enablement.
ticket-bot: Jira INC-789 created from #456712 — assignee: eng-runtime priority: P1.
Ankit (eng-runtime): Looking at the runtime traces now. Preliminary: continuous batching heuristic misfired for requests with large shared prefixes leading to KV cache thrash and elevated tail latency. Can we get a representative prompt and timestamp of a failed call? Also, what's their autoscale policy?
Ethan (Support): Sample prompt (redacted): "summarize patient intake and map to ICD codes..." failed at 2025-11-01T14:22:09Z. Autoscale is standard dedicated pool with burst disabled.
Maya (CS Ops): Action items summary:
- Samir: run enablement session (owner) — target today 16:00 UTC.
- Ankit/eng-runtime: investigate KV eviction heuristic and propose a config fix or fallback routing by EOD.
- Priya: send initial customer acknowledgement + credit offer draft now; schedule 30-min enablement invite (include Jo).
- Jo: confirm renewal stance to customer after enablement.
- Ethan: attach full request traces to INC-789 and leave customer-facing note.
Priya (CSM): Draft ack sent to VeraLabs, offering 1k free embed-units credit and proposed time for enablement. Waiting on Samir for calendar slot.
Samir (CS Lead): Confirmed — I'll do 16:00 UTC. Linking runbook steps in thread and will record session.
Ankit (eng-runtime): Quick mitigation suggestion: temporarily route VeraLabs to embed-v1-stable or enable smaller batch window for their key routes. I'll open a feature flag to force single-request batching for that tenant.
Maya (CS Ops): Perfect. Keep thread updated. After the enablement we'll decide whether to keep fallback permanently or tune quantization/batching. @ticket-bot please add label: cs-escalation.
ticket-bot: Label cs-escalation added to INC-789.
Ethan (Support): I've attached full traces to the Jira and notified the customer that we have an enablement session scheduled. They replied: "Appreciate the quick response — counting on this working before renewal." :thumbsup:
Maya (CS Ops): Great. We'll reconvene after the 16:00 session and post a short comms/status note for Jo to reuse in the renewal call. Thanks everyone.
